metadata.title: Book Translator - AI Book Translation
metadata.description: AI-powered platform for translating English books into Georgian. Upload, translate, read.

home.hero_subtitle: Upload an English book in PDF, EPUB, or DOCX format and get a high-quality Georgian translation powered by Claude AI.
home.feature_ai_desc: High-quality, context-aware translation powered by Claude API.
home.feature_reader_desc: Read translated books in our built-in reader with bookmarks and highlights.
home.feature_tts_desc: Listen to books in Georgian with Text-to-Speech technology.
home.feature_formats_desc: PDF, EPUB, TXT, DOCX — upload books in any format.
home.pricing_new_desc: Full translation from English to Georgian
home.pricing_existing_desc: Access to an already translated book
